subject: Recap & request: confirm economic buyer, legal/procurement contacts, and evaluation criteria
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Patel <dana.patel@nimbushealth.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@nimbushealth.com>
Cc:  
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & request: confirm economic buyer, legal/procurement contacts, and evaluation criteria

Hi Dana / Evan —

Thanks again for the demo and the thoughtful conversation today. Quick recap from our side and two asks to keep momentum:

What we heard as priorities
- Primary use case: triage & summarization for clinical intake workflows (reduce time-to-decision for referrals)
- Decision criteria you mentioned: output fidelity, latency at scale, cost per 10k tokens, and data residency/compliance
- Pilot goals: 4-week technical validation, then 8–12 week procurement/contracting phase

Two quick asks to make the next step efficient:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer who will sign off on budget? From the call it sounded like the CTO/VP of Engineering level — please confirm the name and preferred introduction (email or calendar invite).
2) Please share the procurement & legal contacts we should loop in for routing the SOW/SLA and any standard security questionnaire (we can pre-fill a lot of the SOC2 + data handling answers).

I attached a short mutual action plan (Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx) with proposed milestones and a timeline we typically use for pilots. If you can send the org chart or a simple list of approvers, Ben (solutions) and Laura (my manager) will align on the right technical attendees for the deep-dive.

Suggested next steps
- Technical deep-dive (2hrs) week of June 7 — Ben to run KQ/latency benchmarks and ops questions
- Procurement intro & SOW template exchange the week after

Thanks — copying Ben Carter (solutions) and Laura Bennett (sales manager) on the thread so we can coordinate calendars once we have the contacts.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128
Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (attachment)

From: Dana Patel <dana.patel@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 17:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & request: confirm economic buyer, legal/procurement contacts, and evaluation criteria

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers:
- Economic buyer: Evan Brooks (CTO) — Evan is included on this reply. He’ll make the final call on platform budget and vendor selection.
- Procurement: procurement@nimbushealth.com — they handle routing SOWs and PO issuance. Typical lead time is 6–8 weeks after technical sign-off.
- Legal: Sally Nguyen (sally.nguyen@nimbushealth.com) — she will handle contract language and vendor risk assessments.

I attached our latest org chart (Nimbus_org_chart_v2.pdf) — it shows team leads and dotted-line relationships. For our decision criteria, Evan cares most about latency at 99th percentile and deterministic response formatting; CFO will weigh cost per token and projected monthly spend.

We do want a short security packet you can send over (SOC2 report, data retention policy, and a completed baseline questionnaire). Can you provide those?

Thanks — happy to intro procurement/legal once you send the packet.

Regards,
Dana Patel
Director of Product Operations, Nimbus Health
dana.patel@nimbushealth.com
Nimbus_org_chart_v2.pdf (attachment)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@nimbushealth.com>, Dana Patel <dana.patel@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & request: confirm economic buyer, legal/procurement contacts, and evaluation criteria

Thanks Dana — and great to have Evan on the thread.

Evan — appreciate the clear direction on priorities. I’ve attached (and also linked in HubSpot) a brief security pack and a filled baseline questionnaire to make the legal review quicker. Ben will run the tech deep-dive and demo a small latency test harness; Laura will support on commercial/PO questions.

Quick asks before we set the technical slot:
- Could Evan confirm the weighted decision criteria? For example: Latency (40%), Cost (30%), Output fidelity (20%), Data controls/compliance (10%). If the weights differ, we’ll tailor the pilot pass/fail gates.
- Procurement: could you confirm whether Nimbus requires a vendor risk assessment form in addition to our SOC2? If so, we’ll fill that and return within 48 hours.

Proposed dates for the technical deep-dive (2–2.5 hrs): June 8, June 9, or June 11 (PDT). Please let us know preferred slots and whether procurement/legal prefer an intro only or to sit in on the session.

Links/attachments:
- Redwood baseline security packet: https://drive.redwood.ai/security/nimbus-pack (packet includes SOC2 summary, data retention policy, encryption notes)
- Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (already shared)

If procurement wants, we can send a short SOW template now to speed routing.

Best,
Karthik

Karthik / Dana —

Thanks — I can confirm I’m the economic buyer for this initiative. The weighting Karthik suggested looks reasonable; I’d tighten fidelity at 30% and move 10% from latency to cost (so: Latency 30 / Cost 40 / Fidelity 20 / Compliance 10).

Procurement is procurement@nimbushealth.com (they’ll route PO once terms are agreed). Sally (cc’d) will take the contract & vendor risk assessment. Procurement typically expects a short SOW + pricing and an answer to their standard questionnaire (I’ve attached our procurement routing note).

Sally — when you have a time, a brief intro to your preferred process would help — do you want to exchange the vendor questionnaire first, or review our SOC2 + SOW? We can schedule the technical deep-dive the week of June 8 — I’ll block June 9 at 10am PT tentatively; please let me know if that conflicts.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot plan.

Evan Brooks
CTO, Nimbus Health
